content: SEO prerendering for tool sites: Vue 3 ecosystem has vite-ssg (antfu-collective, active 2026, v27+ ESM-only): wraps app entry ViteSSG(App,{routes},cb), pre-renders every route to static HTML at build, built-in @unhead/vue v2 so useHead() per-component sets title/meta that lands in prerendered HTML, includedRoutes(paths,routes) hook filters which routes generate HTML, built-in critical CSS via beasties, onSSRAppRendered for initialState, ClientOnly component for browser-only UI. Limitation: double payload (full JS still shipped; hydration re-runs). React ecosystem: react-snap is aging/breaking on React 18; headless-browser prerender plugins (@prerenderer/rollup-plugin-prerender, vite-plugin-seo-prerender) or Next.js/Astro are the alternatives. Vite docs officially describe pre-rendering as SSG. For a pure-frontend tool site, prerender + SPA hydration gives per-tool shareable URLs and indexable HTML without a server.
